applies_to.launch: junie --output-format json-stream --project <dir> --task <task> (the session directory's summary.json after the run)
applies_to.selection: the version the capture discovered with junie --version (stderr also states it)

executor: journal-ocsf-writer JunieSummaryMapper (direct Java); the whole document is one record
identity: junie.summary.identity.v1: sessionId names the session; the session events of the same directory carry none and are identified by it
usage: junie.usage.unnamed_cost.v1: a usage entry's cost is a quantity whose unit the source does not name (kind 99 Other, no currency); the per-model costs of the recorded runs sum to completion.taskCostUsd, but a sum in one run does not name their unit

rules.owner: per-model usage (scope 6, final, cumulative) and unnamed-unit cost per model (kind 99, model_ref) from mainAgent.modelUsage

rules.selector: a record that is not one JSON object

rules.owner: the record retained whole with the failure

candidate.status: EXPERIMENTAL candidate (2026-10-24): tested on two sanitized live 3813.7 runs (junie-1, junie-2) and their final assemblies; not admitted: no field-disposition catalog or oracle profile yet; tested candidate behaviour is not approved support
